summary: FEMA major disaster declaration for Alaska (fire), declared 1988-03-11.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (91,000 affected)
summary: TWO ATTACHMENT SCREWS FOR THE THROTTLE POSITION SENSORS COULD LOOSEN AND BACK OUT.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (48 affected)
summary: SOME DEADMAN PEDALS WERE ASSEMBLED WITH INCORRECT BOLTS WHICH COULD CAUSE A MALFUNCTION WITHOUT ANYONE STEPPING ON THE PEDAL.

title: WAYNE WHEELED VEHICLES: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:DOOR AND SIDE (193 affected)
summary: GLASS THAT HAS NOT BEEN TEMPERED WAS USED FOR PASSENGER WINDOWS.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT (4,500 affected)
summary: DRIVER AND RIGHT FRONT PASSENGER INBOARD SEAT BELTS MAY BE IMPROPERLY ANCHORED DUE TO LOOSE NUTS THAT COULD BACK OFF.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS (21,200 affected)
summary: AUTOMATIC RETRACTOR FOR SEAT BELTS FOR DUAL FACING REAR SEATS MAY BE INSTALLED IN AN IMPROPER LOCATION.

title: PEABODY GALION CORP.: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:OTHER PARTS (232 affected)
summary: THE IRREGULAR SURFACE ON THE CYLINDER PISTON ON WHICH A STROKE LIMITING SPACER MUST EXERT FORCE, WHICH CAUSES THE SPACER TO FAIL AND CYLINDER OVERSTROKE TWO INCHES.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:ALTERNATOR:REGULATOR:STARTER:OTH (3,000 affected)
summary: INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE RELOCATED ALTERNATOR WIRING AND THE SOLENOID HOSE ALTERNATOR WIRING STAY BRACKET CAN CAUSE WIRE CHAFFING AND AN ELECTRICAL SHORT.

title: Ford Motor Company: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:TORSION BAR (8,848 affected)
summary: TWO TORSION SPRINGS ATTACHED TO REAR SUSPENSION CONTROL ARMS MAY FRACTURE AND RUB AGAINST A REAR TIRE.

title: DETROIT DIESEL CORP.: ENGINE:PULLEY:CRANKSHAFT (2,993 affected)
summary: THE FRONT CRANKSHAFT PULLEY ISOLATOR ASSEMBLY MAY FAIL DUE TO SEPARATION OF THE PULLEY FROM THE HUB.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:FLEXIBLE (1,256 affected)
summary: THE OIL DIPSTICK TUBE ATTACHING BRACKET MAY HAVE BEEN BENT DURING PRODUCTION OR SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE, REDUCING THE CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE DIPSTICK RING AND THE THROTTLE BELLCRANK LEVER.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (22,300 affected)
summary: THE FUEL FEED OR FUEL RETURN HOSE AT THE ENGINE MAY RUB AGAINST A SHIFT LEVER ON THE 5 SPEED TRANSAXLE.

title: Ford Motor Company: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY:SHAFT AXLE (682 affected)
summary: A DESIGN CHANGE TO FACILITATE CHANGEOVER IN REAR AXLE SHAFT FLANGES INADVERTENTLY PRODUCED THE POSSIBILITY FOR INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE FLANGE AND DISC BRAKE ROTOR.

title: Land Rover: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS (2,954 affected)
summary: A NYLON PIVOT PIN IN THE SEAT BELT RETRACTOR LOCK MECHANISM MAY BE TOO LARGE IN DIAMETER.

title: GENERAL TIRE & RUBBER CO.: TIRES (1,248 affected)
summary: TIRES FAIL TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 119 FOR HIGH SPEED ENDURANCE TEST.

title: UNIROYAL GOODRICH TIRE CO: TIRES:PLY (137 affected)
summary: TIRES FAILED TO MEET THE MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS FOR ENDURANCE OF FMVSS NO. 109.

title: UNIROYAL GOODRICH TIRE CO: TIRES (9,656 affected)

title: UNIROYAL GOODRICH TIRE CO: TIRES (944 affected)
summary: TIRES FAIL TO MEET THE REQUIREMENTS SPECIFIED IN REGULATION 575.104 DURING SURVEILLANCE TESTING FOR GRADE A TEMPERATURE.

title: General Motors, LLC: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS (7,775 affected)
summary: WHEEL LUG NUTS WERE NOT PROPERLY TORQUED TO SPECIFICATIONS.

summary: PERFORATION OF THE FUEL TANK OR THE ATTACHED FUEL FEED PIPE DUE TO CORROSION OF THE TANK OR FUEL FEED PIPE MATERIALS.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:INDICATOR:LEVER (430 affected)
summary: A CLIP ON THE SHIFTER MECHANISM INSIDE THE CONSOLE MAY BECOME DISLODGED PREVENTING INDICATION OF THE CORRECT GEAR SELECTION UNDER CONDITIONS OF DARKNESS.

summary: IN LINE FUEL FILTER LOCATED BETWEEN THE FUEL TANK AND FUEL PUMP COULD SEEP FUEL AT THE SEAM OF THE PLASTIC CASING.

title: General Motors, LLC: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES (282,052 affected)
summary: SECONDARY HOOD LATCH ASSEMBLY MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY ADJUSTED RESULTING IN LATCH BECOMING BENT.

title: General Motors, LLC: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:BRAKE LIGHTS (9,661 affected)
summary: THE STOP LAMP SWITCH MAY HAVE A LOOSE ELECTRICAL CONTACT. THE LOOSE CONTACT CAN OVERHEAT AND MELT THE SURROUNDING PLASTIC CAUSING THE CONTACT TO STICK OPEN.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (2,090 affected)
summary: PERFORATION OF THE FUEL TANK OR ATTACHED FUEL FEED PIPE DUE TO CORROSION OF THE TANK OR FUEL FEED PIPE MATERIALS.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: ENGINE:OTHER PARTS (2,483 affected)
summary: THE POSITIVE CRANKCASE VENTILATION VALVE MAY PROVIDE INADEQUATE AIR FLOW UNDER LOW ENGINE LOAD CONDITIONS.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: STEERING:POWER:SHAFT LOWER WORM (259 affected)
summary: THE STEERING SHAFT SPLINE ENGAGEMENT IS ONLY .52, THE RECOMMENDED ENGAGEMENT IS 2 INCHES.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM (127 affected)
summary: SEAT BELT MOUNTING BOLTS ON THE INBOARD SIDE OF RIDERS SEAT MAY HAVE BEEN UNDERTORQUED.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:UNKNOWN TYPE:LEVER AND LI (17,745 affected)

summary: THE POSITIVE CRANKCASE VENTILATION VALVE MAY PROVIDE INADEQUATE AIR FLOW UNDER LOW ENGINE LOAD CONDITIONS.
